description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three different text annotation tools—TEXTBLOB, VADER, and ChatGPT—when applied to two categories of tweets: those containing emojis and all tweets. The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, while the horizontal axis categorizes the tweets into 'Emoji Tweets' and 'Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis.' Each bar is color-coded and patterned to distinguish between the tools: TEXTBLOB is represented by a white bar, VADER by a black bar, and ChatGPT by a green bar with diagonal stripes. The accuracy of TEXTBLOB is approximately 0.2 for Emoji Tweets and around 0.6 for Overall Tweets. VADER shows an accuracy of about 0.6 for both categories. ChatGPT has the highest accuracy, with approximately 0.8 for Emoji Tweets and around 0.7 for Overall Tweets. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their color and pattern.
